title: Molecularly engineered zeolites with extra-large-pore architectures and functional opportunities
content:
Chem. Soc. Rev., 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5CS00473J, Review Article
Haimei Xu, Xinwei Guan, Lu Lin, Yuanshuai Liu, Zhihao Lei, Xiaoning Li, Shuaiyu Jiang, Zijun Yong, Yibo Ma, Wenping Sun, Hongge Pan, Baohua Jia, Valentin Valtchev, Tianyi Ma
Extra-large-pore (ELP) zeolites bridge micro- and mesoporous materials. This review provides a comprehensive overview of their structural features, advanced characterisation, synthesis methods, representative frameworks, and functional applications.
